metadata.name: oracle_mock
metadata.description: Test-only oracle writer — lets the localnet suite update mock Pyth PriceUpdateV2 accounts mid-test (price, ema, publish_time).

instructions.name: probe_scalar_mul
docs: write the compressed result into `target`[0..32]. Lets the suite verify
the syscall's scalar semantics match curve25519-dalek off-chain.

instructions.name: write_account
docs: Overwrite `data` bytes into `target` at `offset`. Only accounts owned by
this program can be written, so this cannot touch real chain state — and
this program is only ever deployed to the test validator.
